steps.title: Analyze Sound and History Integration
steps.description: Plan UI/UX enhancements to host DTMF click tone triggers, a customizable mute/unmute visual switcher, and persistent calculations log in the Modern Calculator application.

steps.title: Implement FrameLayout Container in Activity Main Layout
steps.description: Convert activity_main.xml structure into a FrameLayout container allowing relative view stacking for the calculation history drawer.

steps.title: Add Sound Toggle and Show History Row
steps.description: Design an inline modern action bar containing a clickable Sound mode switcher and a detailed history pane activator.

steps.title: Design Custom History Panel Overlay
steps.description: Construct overlay elements including history header, clear log button, close action, and dynamic scroll view lists of equations inside the layout XML.

steps.title: Import ToneGenerator and Storage APIs inside MainActivity
steps.description: Declare imports for AudioManager, ToneGenerator, SharedPreferences, and UI layout utility parameters in MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Initialize Tone Feedback Hardware System
steps.description: Configure standard native system media tones inside Android MainActivity onCreate sequence to minimize key tap input delays.

steps.title: Program Persistent Storage Engine for Computations
steps.description: Write efficient serializing methods using Android SharedPreferences to save, list, split, and clear computation expressions history dynamically.

steps.title: Create Dynamic Dynamic History Items Inflator
steps.description: Build interactive history text cards programmatically which restore equations back to the live expression area upon tap, and animate transitions.

steps.title: Connect Sound Switcher and Event Triggers
steps.description: Add on-click operations to button sounds and panel view switches with responsive audio click feedback and saved state configurations.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Compile, execute, and verify interactive mechanical audio click feedback and stored expressions list in Modern Calculator.
